key_insight: SPPS extends Pauli-based simulation from forward-only estimation to large-scale quantum optimization by using stochastic Pauli-path sampling to produce unbiased gradient estimates.
engineering_relevance: This enables practical gradient-based tuning of variational quantum algorithms and parameter initialization at scales that are difficult for existing simulators to handle.
method: Sample Pauli paths stochastically across optimization iterations.
Use the sampled paths to estimate gradients without bias.
Provide convergence guarantees for the resulting optimization process.
evidence_signal: The paper reports benchmarks on quantum eigensolvers up to 100 qubits and quantum neural networks up to 40 qubits, with optimization that tracks dynamics and converges within minutes.
watch_item: Performance depends on stochastic sampling quality, so variance and sampling cost may limit scalability in harder optimization landscapes.
paper_title: Stochastic Pauli-path simulator for large-scale quantum optimization
